cues.zh: 这些墙后面是Crossrail，至少是Crossrail的工地之一。
cues.en: Behind these walls is Crossrail, or at least one of the sites for Crossrail.

cues.zh: 这是目前世界上最大的工程项目之一。
cues.en: It's one of the largest engineering projects happening in the world right now.

cues.zh: 但我不是来谈这个的，我是来谈它听起来是什么样的，
cues.en: But I'm not here to talk about that, I'm here to talk about what it sounds like,

cues.zh: 因为几十年来，世界上每个建筑工地都有这种噪音。
cues.en: because for decades now, every construction site in the world has had this noise.

cues.zh: 当然这是我后期配的音；那是倒车提示音，因为我这儿没有卡车准备碾过我。
cues.en: Now obviously I've dubbed that in afterwards; it's a reversing beep, for I don't have a truck here ready to run me over.

cues.zh: 但在过去十年左右，越来越多地，你听到的是另一种声音。
cues.en: But in the last ten years or so, increasingly, you've been hearing a different noise instead.

cues.zh: 你听到的是这个：
cues.en: You've been hearing this:

cues.zh: 白噪声倒车提示音。
cues.en: a white noise reversing beep.

cues.zh: 它源自2001年利兹大学的一项发明。
cues.en: And that came out of an invention at Leeds University in 2001.

cues.zh: 现在它已成为大多数重大建筑项目的标准，
cues.en: It's now become the standard for most major construction projects

cues.zh: 以至于Crossrail不允许装有老式单音倒车提示器的车辆进入。
cues.en: to the extent that Crossrail does not allow vehicles with an old-school single-tone reversing beeper to actually get in.

cues.zh: 那我为什么提这个？因为这是个挺极客的冷知识。
cues.en: So, why do I mention this? Because it's a fairly geeky fact to know.

cues.zh: 原因有两个。
cues.en: Well, two reasons.

cues.zh: 一是更安全。
cues.en: One is that it's safer.

cues.zh: 你的耳朵能分辨出那种宽带声音、那种白噪声，比分辨哔哔声强得多。
cues.en: Your ears can pick out that broadband sound, that white noise, a lot better than they can pick out beeping.

cues.zh: 也就是说，你可以用更低的音量播放，不那么吵到周围的居民，而且更安全，
cues.en: Which means that you can play it at a lesser volume, not annoy the residents around here as much, and it's safer

cues.zh: 因为你的耳朵能分辨出那个声音，并判断它来自哪里。
cues.en: because your ears can pick out that tone and tell where it comes from.

cues.zh: 单一的单调哔声会产生各种回声效应，
cues.en: A single monotone beep can do all sorts of echo things,

cues.zh: 它不是自然的声音，你的耳朵没受过这种训练，
cues.en: it's not a natural sound, your ears aren't trained for it,

cues.zh: 但白噪声，那种*嘶嘶嘶*的声音，你的大脑能判断出它来自哪里。
cues.en: but white noise, that kind of *pssh pssh pssh*, your brain can pick out where it's from.

cues.zh: 所以如果那里有五辆卡车都在倒车，你也能知道它们的位置。
cues.en: So if you've got five trucks in there, all reversing, you'll know where they are.

cues.zh: 也能知道是不是有一辆快要碾到你了。
cues.en: And you'll know if one is about to run you over.

cues.zh: 这可能是你之前不知道的。
cues.en: And that is something you might not have known.
